title: Da Vinci Banquet Halls — positioning
question: What should future marketing work treat as the durable reason someone picks Da Vinci over another GTA banquet hall?

options.label: Scale + flexible halls
options.thesis: Six configurable halls for 50–1,000 guests — one venue that fits intimate and large events.
options.case: The property size and layout options are the honest differentiator.
options.body: Position around capacity range and hall configurability.

options.label: Italian + South Asian catering
options.thesis: In-house Italian and South Asian menus with event packages — cuisine fit without an outside caterer.
options.case: Menu depth and cultural celebration packages are the differentiator.
options.body: Position around dual cuisine and celebration packages.

options.label: Full-service venue experience
options.thesis: Halls, catering, bar, lighting/sound, and on-site coordination in one booking.
options.case: One-stop planning reduces vendor juggling for hosts.
options.body: Position around turnkey venue + catering + coordination.

options.label: Not decided yet
options.thesis: Keep positioning as an open product fact; don't invent a claim.
options.case: Use steer notes for any soft guidance; leave the claim undecided in PRODUCT.md.
options.body: Record as undecided rather than forcing a slogan.
